A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IPLoc research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support matching retained, relocated, added, and removed content.

before.justification: v1 reports original localization experiments, data-curation ablations, and generalization evaluations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains original experiments and adds larger-model evaluations, detector comparisons, and quantitative prompt ablations.

M1.justification: The proposed procedure remains video-based conversation construction, maximum-interval frame sampling, real/pseudo-name mixing, and LoRA fine-tuning with next-token prediction. Applying this recipe to larger models and testing baseline prompts does not change IPLoc itself.

E1.justification: The training datasets and principal localization and generalization benchmarks remain unchanged. Section 5 adds a briefly reported MS-COCO multi-object localization test; v1 mentioned COCO but did not report this evaluation.

E2.justification: Beyond the three original VLM baselines, v2 Table 2 adds Pixtral-12B, GPT-4o, Qwen2-VL-72B, and InternVL2-76B. Tables 7–8 additionally compare IPLoc with CD-ViTO, TFA, and OwlViT, substantially broadening the evaluated comparator set.

E3.justification: v2 introduces 72B fine-tuning and larger-model evaluations, a denser 1–8-shot ICL-LASOT evaluation, and baseline prompt sweeps with selection by aggregate performance (Appendix D). It removes evaluation with IoUex. The principal mIoU metric and stated 50/50 LaSOT category split remain.

E4.justification: v2 adds extensive prompt-sensitivity experiments and response-level failure cases, a denser shot-count analysis, and 72B generalization-retention checks. Existing data-source, semantic-coherence, pseudo-name, and LLaVA analyses largely remain. The copying examples and IoUex diagnostic in v1 Figures 3–4 are removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Both principally report point estimates; SEED refers to a benchmark, not random-seed reporting.

E6.justification: Between v1 Table 1 and v2 Table 2, Qwen2-VL-7B's ICL-LASOT 4-shot score changes from 21.89 to 46.29, and IPLoc-7B's Real + Pseudo 8-shot score changes from 33.95 to 55.21. The PDFs do not explain these revisions. Numerous larger-model, detector, prompt-ablation, and multi-object results are added, while the IoUex results and detailed SEED image/video scores are removed.

T1.justification: v1's Equation 1 defining IoUex, its mathematical explanation, and its multi-shot selection rule are deleted. The conversation and bounding-box notation remain, with no added theorems, proofs, or substantive derivations.

C1.justification: The central claim of improving personalized localization through curated instruction tuning while retaining generalization remains. v2 drops the headline contribution of a copying-related metric and explicitly emphasizes GPT-4o's weaknesses and effectiveness across 7B–72B models in the abstract and introduction.

C2.justification: v2 substantially expands explanations of failure through prompt-format compliance, model-scale effects, and possible difficulty with longer contexts. Section 5 explicitly limits the studied setting to single-object output and hypothesizes a training-data explanation for poor multi-object localization. The earlier copying-based interpretation is removed.

D1.justification: v2 adds test-set category, object-density, and conversation counts; exact baseline prompts; the GPT-4o model snapshot and high-detail image setting; and a planned release of the data mixes. Conversely, SEED split sample counts disappear. Training documentation still largely refers to LlamaFactory defaults.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations supporting the new VLM and detector comparisons and discussion of scaling and context length, while removing the earlier Qwen technical-report reference. The related-work section's principal VLM/ICL framing and the claimed novelty of personalized localization remain substantially intact.

P1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and results discussion receive targeted rewrites. Model and metric descriptions are removed, ablations are reordered, and limitations and a prompt-ablation appendix are introduced. The main section sequence and most methodological prose remain recognizable.

P2.justification: v2 transposes and expands the main results table, replaces several ablation bar charts with tables, revises Figure 1's examples, and adds a shot-count curve, dataset statistics, and extensive prompt/response displays. The older appendix localization examples are retained but redistributed throughout the expanded supplement.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially strengthens the empirical foundation through stronger VLM and detector comparisons and explicit prompt controls. Appendix D shows why these controls matter: Qwen2-VL-72B's mean score changes from 7.69 with the original prompt to 34.21 with the selected prompt. Scaling and retention checks better support applicability, and the single-object limitation clarifies scope. Removed copying diagnostics and SEED details, unexplained score revisions, and inconsistencies such as Table 4's 72B label versus Section 4.3's 7B description temper, but do not outweigh, these gains.
